Lu Shiyuan (Page 22) saw the Queen of Heaven walking out of it first, and then, another figure appeared behind her. The reason why the disciple from Tiandou Temple dared to say that it was not Biluocao was because he had purchased medicinal herbs all year round. He knew something was wrong at a glance, but what was wrong, and what kind of medicinal herb it was, he couldn't tell. In the east of South America, on the bottom of the Atlantic Ocean, a nuclear submarine was slowly heading south. Moving forward in the extreme direction, it was the submarine that Kallen had hit last time. Afterwards, Lai Ying explained to his wife what happened at the amusement park, and said that it was Pang Fei who helped, which also made his wife sigh. When Wang Mu looked up, the invisible light curtain was still far away, and it had swept past him in the blink of an eye. Wang Mu suddenly shook, as if all the strength in his body had been taken away, and he suddenly became weak and fell to the ground. Lingdang looked at Feng Yu's expression and nodded. The things in the wooden box were very important to Feng Yu, so she didn't dare to delay. After a while, Xi Bei and Coral holding the Shark Soul Dinghai Staff slowly swam over, and Tai Tai. Yilongwen hung quietly beside Mu Yuncheng, not leaving for a moment. Nan Xi made a faint sound on the tip of her tongue, but Ou Guan heard it very clearly. She was calling Zhuo Ling, she was calling her lover. Zhang Lin looked at the huge glacier rift. The mood was a bit depressing. After all, this is where those terrifying monsters came from. The words of the Xie family's aunt reminded Xie Di that very few people knew about this matter. Unless someone did it deliberately, Xie Li would never do it for no reason. Knowing his own life experience. "Shut up!" Young Master Yan became angry and gritted his teeth. Then, he took out a handkerchief and covered his nose, raised his head, and strode away with fast and heavy steps.
